```{r}

source(params$helpers)
```

These reports show the state of the IPBES Zotero groups, and list the items
in each group which should be corrected. Open the report of a group for the
details and for links to the items in Zotero.

## Groups

```{r}
groups <- lapply(
  seq_along(params$metrics),
  function(i) {
    m <- readRDS(params$metrics[[i]])
    checks <- rep_checks(m)
    tibble::tibble(
      Group = paste0(
        "[", params$names[[i]], "](", params$reports[[i]], '){target="_blank"}'
      ),
      Items = nrow(m$items),
      `With DOI` = paste0(round(m$identifiers$met_id_doi$zotero$pc), "%"),
      `Please fix` = sum(checks$count[checks$status == "Please fix"]),
      `Please check` = sum(checks$count[checks$status == "Please check"]),
      Zotero = paste0(
        "[open](https://www.zotero.org/groups/", params$ids[[i]],
        '){target="_blank"}'
      )
    )
  }
)

knitr::kable(
  dplyr::bind_rows(groups),
  align = c("l", "r", "r", "r", "r", "l")
)
```

**Please fix**: number of items with errors. **Please check**: number of
items which may need a correction.

## Metrics documentation

The measures calculated for each group, and what they contain.

```{r}
#| output: asis
docs <- readLines(params$docs)
docs <- docs[docs != "# Metrics"]
cat(sub("^(#+) ", "\\1# ", docs), sep = "\n")
```
